name: S3 / R2
summary: Object storage such as Amazon S3 and Cloudflare R2 holds files, artifacts, attachments and archived transcripts by key. R2 implements the S3 API, so the same clients work against both. Conditional writes (If-Match, If-None-Match) let agents update objects without overwriting each other's changes.
facts: S3 Files (NFS, GA April 2026); R2 FUSE mounts in Cloudflare Containers
watchOut: No in-place appends; logs must be rewritten or chunked into objects
Request latency is higher than local disk or a database
R2 does not implement every S3 API feature
